author: somnergy
content:
We are happy to announce our alpha.6 release of Zilkworm. 
https://github.com/erigontech/zilkworm/releases/tag/v0.1.0-alpha.6

This comes with yet another innovative state-management solution - the HashState. This does not rely on the pre-indexed maps like our previous DirectState runner and can therefore run `statelessInputBytes` (SLIB as we call it) directly.

Our ERE integration is now complete. Thank you <@745384946310578317>!

We also included a number of new optimizations and fixes. Here's a snippet he new sepolia block tests against Reth and our DirectState backend.

Sepolia, blocks 11905100..11905199, `estimate-cost` (SP1 v6.6.0, ere v0.18.1):

```
+----------------------+---------+---------+-------+
| Client               | matched | Cost(G) | Z/R   |
+----------------------+---------+---------+-------+
| HashState            | 100/100 |  7,398  | 0.477*|
| Reth 0.1.0-rc.4      |  98/100 | 15,498  |       |
| Direct.S + adptr.    | 100/100 |  7,653  | 0.494 |
+----------------------+---------+---------+-------+

* cheaper on 98/100
```
